name: SMUD High School Internship Program
org: SMUD with Sacramento Employment and Training Agency (Sacramento Works)
what_you_do: You do a paid six-week summer internship in areas such as IT, engineering, customer service, vehicle mechanics, accounting, HR and marketing.
who_can_apply: 16 or older (by June 2 in the 2026 cycle), current junior or senior, 2.5 GPA or higher, attends an eligible school in the service area, no relatives who work for the internship host, own transportation.
pay_detail: $16.90 per hour (2026), about 36 hours per week.
deadline_text: 2026 cycle: applications opened Mar 23, 2026 and closed May 1, 2026 (5 pm). 2027 dates not posted yet.
how_to_apply: Apply on the Sacramento Works site before the deadline. Steps: application review, document check, computer random drawing (55 candidates), work readiness workshops and video interview, manager review, in-person interview. Up to 25 interns are chosen.
notes: Questions: SacramentoWorksFor.Youth@seta.net. Random drawing means even qualified students may not be picked. Check the school list on the Sacramento Works SMUD page. Age rule and school-area details come from the 2026 posting; confirm for 2027.
